description: This file implements the Python bindings for the torch::Event class, including creation, deallocation, recording, waiting, querying, and other operations related to CUDA or device events in PyTorch.

classes.name: THPEvent
classes.description: Python wrapper for c10::Event, representing device events in PyTorch.

methods.name: THPEvent_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new torch.Event object with specified device and flags.

methods.name: THPEvent_new
methods.description: Creates a new torch.Event object with given device type and event flag.

methods.name: THPEvent_dealloc
methods.description: Deallocates the torch.Event object, releasing resources.

methods.name: THPEvent_get_device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the event.

methods.name: THPEvent_record
methods.description: Records the event on a specified stream or current stream.

methods.name: THPEvent_from_ipc_handle
methods.description: Creates an event from an IPC handle (not supported yet).

methods.name: THPEvent_ipc_handle
methods.description: Returns the IPC handle for the event (not supported yet).

methods.name: THPEvent_wait
methods.description: Blocks until the event is completed, optionally on a specified stream.

methods.name: THPEvent_query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: THPEvent_elapsed_time
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time between this event and another.

methods.name: THPEvent_synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the host thread with the event.

methods.name: THPEvent_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.

methods.name: THPEvent_init
methods.description: Initializes the torch.Event type in the module.
